card.name: Partway through split-up names and words
card.fires_on: Pieces in the middle of a longer word or name that has been split, such as the MB in EMBRYO or the im in zemljepisnih imen. It also fires on short linking words inside proper names.

card.writes: It suppresses the reg- spelling and promotes the word regional in several languages, so it seems to shift the model toward regional and away from reg-.
card.plain: It fires partway through split words, mainly the MB in EMBRYO in warning headings, and it relates to the idea of regional.
